test_title: PYST 48: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Catch someone's eye

options.text: To irritate or annoy someone intentionally
To physically capture someone's gaze and hold it, making them unable to look away
To attract someone's attention or to be noticed by them
To surprise someone with unexpected behaviour

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Catch someone's eye"** means to attract someone's attention or to be noticed by them. (किसी का ध्यान आकर्षित करना) • **Example:** The bright red dress in the shop window immediately caught my eye. • **Catch someone's attention** is the essence of this idiom. It is often used to describe something visually striking or appealing. (ध्यान आकर्षित करना) • **Example:** The colorful advertisements on the billboard caught everyone's eye on the busy street. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: To irritate or annoy someone intentionally** (किसी को जानबूझकर परेशान करना) • **Example:** He kept tapping his pen on the table just to irritate me. • **Option 2: To physically capture someone's gaze and hold it, making them unable to look away** (किसी की नज़र को शारीरिक रूप से पकड़ना और उसे हटा पाने में असमर्थ बनाना) • **Example:** The mesmerizing painting seemed to physically capture everyone's gaze in the gallery. • **Option 4: To surprise someone with unexpected behavior** (किसी को अप्रत्याशित व्यवहार से चौंकाना) • **Example:** His sudden outburst of anger surprised everyone at the meeting. 41:Tb6a, The correct answer is **Option 3**.
